_README: Canonical shared contract for the agent memory framework (M8). Pure data. Generated into adapter/harness/agent_memory/_core_generated.py and packages/aielia/src/_memory-core-generated.ts by spec/gen-memory-core.mjs. Algorithms are hand-mirrored in each runtime and pinned by conformance fixtures; TS source of truth: packages/aielia/src/{memory-service,memory-governance,fact-extraction}.ts. Wire format is the TS camelCase JSON; the Python generated file snake_cases object KEYS only (never values).

fact_fields._README: One entry per UserFact field. port: yes = ported to Python, deferred = reserved. judgement is transient: never persisted, stripped by the gate.
fact_fields.rejected_fact_fields: same shape as fact_fields (a rejected fact is a UserFact)

store_keys._README: Wire key names, verbatim. scope: global survives /new, session is cleared by it. port: yes/deferred.

fact_identity.supersession_key_scope: same key and same project (absent project = empty string)

budget._README: renderFactsBlock. header counts toward the budget. A line that does not fit is skipped; a later shorter one may still fit.
budget.unconfirmed_when: source = model_inferred and confidence in (medium, low)
budget.fit_rule: skip a line that does not fit; a later, shorter line may still fit
budget.scope_filter: fact with no project, or project equal to the current one
budget.merge_rule: durable first, then session facts whose text is not already among durable

tier_rules._README: TIER_RULES as in fact-extraction.ts; rule_order is first-match structural tier selection (no text inspection). Condition nodes: {field, eq} | {field, neq} | {field, present} | {not: node} | {all: [nodes]} | {always: true}. neq on an absent field is false (origin absent = user).

write_route._README: resolveWriteRoute decision table, every combination. writerClass in_turn = writer in_turn; cross_turn = digest/reviewer/consolidation. confidence null = absent. In-turn non-model facts follow their own durable bit; in-turn model facts: not durable gives session, high gives pending only under user_only else durable, medium gives pending, low or absent gives session; cross-turn: not durable or low gives session, else durable only in auto else pending. This table is also the fixture oracle.

gate._README: admit_candidate as an ordered pipeline over a derived context: gateOn, judged (non-user origin OR source = model_inferred), judgementComplete (both containsSecret and looksLikeInstruction are booleans), containsSecret, redactedNonEmpty (trimmed redactedText non-empty), looksLikeInstruction, nonUser (origin != user). A rule matches when every key in "when" equals the context value ({} always matches). Rules run in order; effects apply; a terminal rule stops. The transient judgement is always stripped. Default origin user is applied except on the gate-off path, which returns the candidate unchanged minus judgement.

audit.seq_rule: per owner, strictly increasing from 1 (continues from the last entry)
audit.rotation_rule: keep the last `keep` entries plus any entry whose seq is above the consolidation watermark (memory:consolidation-state.lastSeq, default 0)
audit.redaction_invariant: entries only ever hold post-gate text

undo_rules.message: Entry #{seq} was erased from history and cannot be restored.
Entry #{seq} belongs to a group; undoing grouped entries is not supported in this runtime.

undo_entry.swap: before and after of the undone entry are swapped
